message.content:
A typical medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
Calories can vary slightly depending on the tomato’s size and variety:

| Size (approx. weight) | Calories |
|-----------------------|----------|
| Small (≈90 g)         | ~15      |
| Medium (≈123 g)       | ~22      |
| Large (≈182 g)        | ~33      |

These values are for raw, fresh tomatoes. Cooking methods or added ingredients will change the calorie content.
